notes.title: Auditorium Update Released
notes.notes: This update fixes the end-of-game announcement thanking users for playing the demo version of the game. Credits now roll instead. This update also significantly improves upon the quality of graphics at higher resolutions. Graphics are now rendered by GPU instead of CPU, allowing for smoother pixel interpolation. Auditorium's native resolution is still 830x466 pixels.

notes.title: New Release - Auditorium
notes.notes:
Auditorium is now available on Steam!

From the award-winning team that brought you Fractal, comes this classic particle puzzler about discovery. There are no right or wrong answers, and there are any number of ways to solve each puzzle. To get started, turn up your sound and fill up the first audio container!
